objective.primaryRule: NL0 1.0.0 §3.5 original rule: the actual-profit role among the Q1-Q6 qualified members (highest centre net; ties: higher selection robust net, lower centre DD, label), per arm population (D, G, C, J, S) at every cutoff; RA1 report-only. The determination (PROTOCOL.md §12) is a separate precommitted governance label.

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 initial trading allocation (not peak account equity); P0 = 35 % of it; trade principal loss, banked-capital DD and giveback are report-only

budget.notes: Distinct candidate proposals: the configured base broad lanes x (512 screen + 2 x 256 island) per cutoff — D 32, G 48, J 192, S 18 x 9 lanes (F = 3) — over 4 cutoffs, before refinement designs, extension islands and replicate rounds (PROTOCOL.md §7.6). Backend evaluations: the hard ceiling of 120,000,000 requested official evaluations (archive hits included; fresh and hits reported separately; ledger over the sealed stage records); deterministic bounds 90,000 per broad lane, 179,000 per refinement lane, 650/652 per qualified member, 306 per slice subject.

evaluationBackend.notes: Every official evaluation (searches, replicate rounds, qualification, fold slices, validation) runs only through openOfficialGpuSession -> GpuPool -> EvalLab on the accepted GPU Phase 7 evaluator (record sha256 bb0e3fcf..., binary gb7 cb2ff30b..., RTX 5090 GPU-ae5f222c...), node --no-maglev, one held job per stage; no CPU fallback. Engineering gates, data tools, the pilot and report-only diagnostics are non-official (parity-test / benchmark / diagnostic).

chronologicalConsequence: Standard 3.0.0 §1.8 default, adopted: a failed or uncomputable independent verdict of an arm's procedure means 'no chronological support: the selection is not a deployment-qualified candidate without an explicit user decision'. Governance only. 'No qualifying TSLA candidate' is a valid outcome.

deviations.description: The TSLA space: Assignment 3's genome semantics on the one trading slot (the accepted engine's VGT slot carries TSLA; GDX books disabled; no evaluation file changed); arms D (8 D1 cells), G (6 Growth exit-protection cells), J (48), S (frozen D1 × 6), C (fixed pairs). S1 absent; shadow eligibility OFF; calendar-day holds.

Effort by replicates of NL0's unchanged per-lane schedules (D 4, G 8, J 4, S R_S(F) = max(4, ceil(160 / (6F))) = 9 for F = 3 base replicates; 4 refinement lanes per refined cell) with Priority 5's two-tier island rule and convergence-driven replicate rounds (<= 4, 2 %).
deviations.justification: Brief §4 (substantial, fair, convergence-driven effort); NL0 §7.4 scaling; Priority 5 AD2/AD3.

deviations.description: Priority 5's exact sequential drawdown statistic from GPU marks; one procedure per arm.
deviations.justification: The accepted GPU path returns no minute mark series; a CPU-scored official statistic is forbidden (§9.2).

deviations.description: NL0's original rule is THE selector; RA1 computed on the identical populations as a separately labelled report-only experimental selector (never selects).

Method comparison: C (separately optimized, pooled), J (joint), S (D1-first sequential), with D and G standalone; matched rules; effort matched by the frozen R_S rule (S + its D1 step >= J) and disclosed per arm.
Assignment 3's instrument on the TSLA slot in this study's seed namespace, common random numbers across centres and arms; arm S's design neighbourhoods never move the frozen D1.
deviations.justification: Brief §6 Stage E ('Do not let D1 drift').

deviations.description: Priority 5's eight stresses (cost 0/2/10/20 bps, 14 % interest, stop slippage +10/+25 bps, next-open stops).

Precommitted determination: finalists, development and chronological labels sealed before FULL; architecture comparisons with Priority 5's bands ($10,000 / $5,000 / $2,500) and replication; 'no qualifying TSLA candidate' valid.
D1 hold-window tail stress on pre-2016 TSLA daily data (2010-06-29 -> 2015-12-31, Yahoo; disjoint) plus in-sample.
The common complete endpoint is TSLA's 2026-10-30 (the program's); later sessions not downloaded.
No TSLA incumbent: no informed lane; New L0's and N/original's VGT books are external controls only.
Combined arms require both TSLA books funded (Q6); protected and unrestricted Growth structures protected by cells and reported as sub-populations.
TSLA's split ledger is the study's own file in the central schema, applied by the canonical function (the central splits.json is sha-pinned by frozen studies).
deviations.justification: Frozen studies' integrity guards; brief §2 ('use existing corporate-action adjustment pipelines').
